scope: Complete six-class manual manufacturing reading of the identified published front wall. Every emitted row has an exact answer and a scoped diagnosis. An answer is not print, pressure, strength or service-life acceptance. This record describes the current article; ordinary dock joints use the continuous supported stock.

publication.scope: Selected actual local/pointer/catalog hashes and served aggregate bytes; no bundle-wide source-proof claim.

current_export_delta.scope: Exact actual exported native front-top difference after the continuous saddle underside correction. Only additive stock below the retained interfaces is present. No test or acceptance result is inferred for printed strength or lifetime.

native_scope.retained_true_sections: 64 valve fixtures, two seam/roof transitions, two display-wing corners. Finite native correspondence identifies unchanged scope; it accepts none of those thin sections.

limits: Retained valve, seam/display and cosmetic thin features remain unqualified; their exact answers preserve scope rather than accept them.
Boundary and strict-threshold classifications need native material sections. The related dock/shell reviews also document air-crossing pairs and default print-pose limits.

No new dock physical acceptance exists. Pressure retention, seal forces, cleaning exposure, permanent receiver life, internal prepared-pump fit and failed-pump depressurization remain qualification work.
The global artifact bundle records unproven producer debt; the selected article hashes and native scopes here are independently bound.
